raw: Recap from tonight's PTA meeting. So the people who could make it are in the loop. We talked about a bunch of things, so I'll go through them one at a time. The fall fundraiser did better than we expected, and the board voted to put most of it toward new library books, and you know, the rest towards the playground shade structure. The teachers asked us for more volunteers at lunch duty, especially on Fridays, because they're stretched really thin. There is a sign-up sheet going around, and they love even one shift a month. The carpool line is still a mess in the mornings. The principal is going to try a staggered drop-off by grade starting after the holiday, so watch for an email about that. We also decided to bring back the family movie night in the gym probably once a month in the winter, and we need someone to take the lead on organizing snacks. Last thing, a few parents raised concerns about how much homework the fourth graders are getting, and the principal agreed to bring it up at the next staff meeting and report back to us. Next meeting is in four weeks, same time in the cafeteria
